name: Ashfrost Assassin
tactics: An ashfrost assassin hides in an enclosed space, then surprises its prey with ashfrost torrent. It maneuvers around the battlefield with ashfrost slide, battering foes to the ground with slam attacks all the while. It hammers a prone foe, then knocks it down again, preferably with a recharged ashfrost torrent.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: An ashfrost assassin deals 1d8 extra cold damage and 1d8 extra fire damage against any creature granting combat advantage to it instead of knocking that creature prone.

traits.name: Mutable Form
traits.details: When squeezing, an ashfrost assassin moves at full speed, provokes no opportunity attacks for squeezing, and does not take a -5 penalty to attack rolls for squeezing.

traits.name: Flowing Slurry
traits.details: An ashfrost assassin can move across liquid and ignores difficult terrain.

hit.description: cold damage plus 1d6 + 3 fire damage, and the target is knocked prone and cannot stand up until the end of the ashfrost assassin’s next turn

effect.description: The ashfrost assassin moves its speed and can make a slam attack at any point during this movement. It doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when moving away from the target

powers.name: Ashfrost Torrent
powers.usageDetails: 6, or recharges when the ashfrost assassin takes cold or fire damage

hit.description: cold damage plus 2d6 +3 fire damage, and the target is knocked prone
